# expo_google_service_account_key (Resource)

Uploads a Google service account key (JSON key file) to the EAS account. Use its `id` as `expo_android_app_credentials.google_service_account_key_id` for Play Store submissions. To reference a key that is already in EAS, use the `expo_google_service_account_key` data source instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "expo_google_service_account_key" "this" {
  key_json = file("${path.module}/play-service-account.json")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON contents of the Google service account key file, e.g. `file("service-account.json")`.

### Read-Only

- `client_email` (String) Google Service Account Email
- `client_identifier` (String) Google Service Account Identifier
- `id` (String) EAS Id of the Google Service Account Key
- `private_key_identifier` (String) Identifier of the private key (`private_key_id` in the JSON key file)
- `project_identifier` (String) GCP project id of the key (`project_id` in the JSON key file)
